<h1>Tort Law &amp; Medical Liability</h1>
<section class="program-overview" aria-labelledby="torts-liability-overview">
<h2 id="torts-liability-overview">Overview</h2>
<p>I study medical malpractice and tort law, including apology laws, punitive damages, liability rules, medical devices, and malpractice safe harbors. This work examines how liability rules affect behavior, risk, compensation, patient safety, and health care.</p>
</section>
